Date: 2026-10-01 13:05 PDT
Subject: RE: RE: Intro + proposed SE demo slots — Archon follow-up

Naomi / Karthik —

We can do the two-step approach. Plan:
1) Wed 10/6 13:00 PT: 45-minute architecture walk + simulated demo using a local sandbox and recorded KV cache flows. No keys required — we'll show the same request patterns and latency profiles.
2) Thu 10/7 08:30 PT: 60-minute secure-run with their security lead and an engineer on their network. For the secure run I need:
   - A temporary read-only test key for a sandbox endpoint OR a tcp endpoint for a private VPC peering test (customer preference).
   - A basic dataset (anonymized) for request shaping (CSV < 50MB).
   - An ISO time at least 24 hours before the secure run to test connectivity.

I'll prepare a short checklist for the customer (I'll attach the network_config_request.xlsx).

— Mina, Solutions Engineering
